description: This file defines the CalculatorUI class, a Swing-based graphical user interface for a calculator application. It manages UI components such as display, number buttons, and operation buttons, and interacts with the Calculator backend to perform calculations.

classes.name: CalculatorUI
classes.description: A Swing JFrame that provides the user interface for the calculator, including display and operation buttons, and handles user interactions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that creates and displays the CalculatorUI window.

methods.name: CalculatorUI
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the calculator backend and sets up the GUI components.

methods.name: setupGUI
methods.description: Configures the main GUI layout, including display and buttons panels.

methods.name: setupDisplay
methods.description: Initializes and adds the display text field to the GUI.

methods.name: setupButtonsPanel
methods.description: Creates the panel that holds number and operation buttons.

methods.name: setupNumberButtons
methods.description: Creates number buttons (0-9 and decimal point) and adds them to the UI.

methods.name: addNumberButton
methods.description: Creates a single number button with specified label and adds it to the number panel.

methods.name: setupCommandButtons
methods.description: Creates operation buttons based on the Operations instance and adds them to the UI.

methods.name: addCommandButton
methods.description: Creates a command button for a specific operation index and adds it to the command panel.

methods.name: actionPerformed
methods.description: Handles button click events and delegates to the calculator logic.

methods.name: setDisplayText
methods.description: Updates the calculator display with the given text.

methods.name: getDisplayText
methods.description: Returns the current text from the display.
